description: List every printing of the card at this set code and collector number, most valuable first. Use this to compare what the same card costs across sets, or to find a cheaper printing. Prefer it over search_cards for that: search_cards matches names by substring, so it also returns unrelated cards whose names merely contain the term. The addressed printing is included in the results.

setNumber.description: Collector number within the set (e.g. '161'). String, not int - some sets use suffixes like '12a'.

name: get_card_printings
